authority_boundary: On-demand program, not fourth persistent implementation slot; GATE-01 source/design only. Future GATE-09..13 product/provider implementations require separately CURRENT-selected scope and real dependencies; GATE-14 final owner-only gate.
publication_rule: PR-only protected main, immutable exact head, required validations and fresh-base integration; no automatic successor.

tranches.name: OPS5 scope, evidence audit & architecture
tranches.scope: Source-ranked OPS5/SBEC/BESF/UADS/SA-BILL/SCEV/XTRA analysis, provider-neutral architecture, program registry, decision register, acceptance map.
tranches.acceptance: All 14 tranches coherent, current source and status pinned, persistent lanes untouched; GATE-01 source-design candidate passes OPS5 PR gate.

tranches.name: Membership, capability and ownership policies
tranches.scope: Free, Subscriber, Sponsored Month and single Campaign Allowance distinguish resource permission, account role and ownership; price remains parameter.
tranches.acceptance: Per-action capability and content/resource matrix, read/export/lapse behavior, one subscription for GM and Player roles, no inferred unlimited AI.

tranches.name: Provider-neutral account/checkout interfaces
tranches.scope: Contract canonical subject-to-provider customer linking, checkout intents, receipt ownership, provider-specific adapters and cancellations.
tranches.acceptance: Contract models reject wrong product, wrong owner, copied proof, redirect spoof and source-agnostic access.

tranches.name: Billing lifecycle and event reconciliation
tranches.scope: Normalize verified subscriptions, paid-through, renew intent, failure/grace/hold, refunds, event replay, out-of-order delivery and provider-state refresh.
tranches.acceptance: State-transition and deterministic temporal/adversarial matrices with explicit pending policy and no premature cancellation revocation.

tranches.name: PostgreSQL ledger, invariants and atomicity
tranches.scope: Propose DDL, unique purchase ownership, idempotent event log, serializable allowance grant slots, source revision and monotonic revocation.
tranches.acceptance: Executable isolated DB tests can prove 100 concurrent attempts yield one grant; research fixtures are not production proof.

tranches.name: Campaign allowances and sponsored access
tranches.scope: One slot per Campaign+Player; subscribed GM eligible issuance; one content root+verified dependencies; campaign-only use, preserved restricted characters.
tranches.acceptance: Deny laundering/copy/export/search/AI and cross-Campaign transfer; retain independent rights; differentiate Sponsored Month from Campaign Allowance.

tranches.name: Offline license/device security design
tranches.scope: Account+device-bound signed finite leases; encrypted content; known revocation, account switching, replay, trusted time and offline sync reconciliation.
tranches.acceptance: Continuity on unchanged signed-in device while offline under verified paid-through; fail closed on wrong device/rollback; no guaranteed early remote revocation.

tranches.name: Storefront, taxes, consumer disclosure and economics
tranches.scope: Conditional Stripe-direct Windows, Google Play Android and future iOS adapter; current region-sensitive compliance, tax/consumer rights and fee-cost model.
tranches.acceptance: No global payment-rate assertion or publication; all merchant/jurisdiction, MCB price claims and legal matters pending decision.

tranches.name: Authoritative backend and database staging
tranches.scope: Implement verified server ledger and resource-scoped authorization with atomic migrations only under separately authorized product lane and verified PCV-03F identity/service.
tranches.acceptance: Real isolated PostgreSQL/API and authentication boundary tests, safe migration/rollback and no production payment.

tranches.name: Stripe signed test-mode integration
tranches.scope: Actual test-mode Checkout, webhook verification, current-provider lookup, customer portal and billing/refund failure recovery after owner-provided test credentials.
tranches.acceptance: Signed test events and reconciliation prove real integration; no live charges or credentials in source.

tranches.name: Installed Windows/Android subscription journeys
tranches.scope: Same account on two devices, three independent accounts Raven1/Raven2/Zak1, subscription lapses, restore/reinstall/offline, correct Android storefront flow.
tranches.acceptance: Installed-device and real service test receipts; no mock-only equivalence; wrong-account protected content denied.

tranches.name: Independent adversarial security acceptance
tranches.scope: Cross-account/copy, webhook replay, idempotency, GM slot racing, dependency provenance, export/search/AI leakage, tampered offline cache.
tranches.acceptance: Independent authentic service/native boundary review and negative cases pass with residual risks recorded.

tranches.name: Support, reconciliation and incident operations
tranches.scope: Operator ledger reconciliation, refunds, privacy requests, key rotation, provider outage, backup/restore and real unit economics.
tranches.acceptance: Actual controlled restore/reconciliation evidence, operational runbook and no hypothetical invoice presented as revenue.

tranches.name: Commercial release decision and owner approval
tranches.scope: Final signed owner decision on pricing/store/merchant, terms and taxes, user consent, security, operations and release.
tranches.acceptance: No production/live checkout, public SKU or paid activation absent all current legal, provider, product and owner gates.
